name: Diver Freya

intro.text: I dive the wrecks round Sumburgh. Cold? It's colder than a Tuesday in Glasgow. But the water is clear and the otters wave at you, so I forgive the frostbite.

win: Swimmingly done. I'll dry off now.
after: Shetland otters live on the coast, in the sea. They eat fish and crabs among the kelp and sleep in holts above the shore. You might see one at dusk, rolling in the weed with a crab.
